steps.message: You are a helpful assistant that can interact with a computer.

Please solve this issue: Each customer's aggregated usage reaches the metric store by business, customer and dimension. Each business keeps a billing catalogue in the billing bucket with plans, dimensions, allowances, overage rules, invoice settings and customer assignments. The invoicing collector already reads both. Charge only permitted usage beyond a finite exhausted allowance; an unlimited or unexhausted allowance, or a plan that forbids overage, charges nothing. Give a dimension a line whenever the customer owes something on it, and give a dimension the plan prices at zero a line unless the invoice settings hide free dimensions. A dimension's line reports the quantity the customer owes for, even where the plan prices it at zero. This task includes a local AWS-compatible emulator at the preconfigured AWS_ENDPOINT_URL. Its credentials and region are already in the shell, the repository's AWS SDK clients use it, and no real AWS account is involved. You may inspect its resources while developing and testing.

-   Latest version of [NVM](https://github.com/nvm-sh/nvm)

For the remainng item of this list, you should figure out yourself if you don't already know.

The implementation is complete. Summary of my changes:

**`src/offering/entities/offeringPackage.entity.ts`** (the metered line assembly used by the invoicing collector):
- Added `Offering.overageIsPermitted` — overage must be affirmatively allowed (`overageAllowed: 'true'`); anything else keeps the customer inside their allowance.
- Added `Offering.billableQuantity` — the quantity a customer owes for on a dimension: full usage when the plan grants no allowance, nothing for an unlimited (`inf`) allowance, nothing when the allowance is unexhausted or the plan forbids overage, and only the spill past a finite exhausted allowance otherwise.
- Added `Offering.freeDimensionsAreHidden` / `Offering.dimensionEarnsLine` — a dimension earns a line whenever the customer owes something on it; a dimension the plan prices at zero also earns a line unless the business' invoice settings (`freeDimensionOnInvoice: 'hide'`) hide free dimensions.
- The non-tiered dimension branch of `getLineItemsForUsage` now reports the owed quantity (allowance-aware, still divided by `usageIncrement`), normalises an unpriced dimension to a zero rate instead of `NaN`, and only adds the line when it is earned.

**`src/microservices/invoiceLineGatherer/invoiceLineGatherer.service.ts`**: usage is now read from the metric store for the period actually being invoiced when the run overrides the catalogue's period.

**`src/offering/entities/offeringPackageEntitlement.spec.ts`**: new unit tests covering all allowance/overage/free-dimension combinations.

Verified end-to-end against the local AWS emulator: `biz-ridge` (settings hide free dimensions) now bills 100 API calls @0.01 and only the 2 seats past the 10-seat allowance, dropping the free alerts dimension, the overage-forbidden reports, the unlimited-allowance storage and the unexhausted minutes; `biz-vale` (show) keeps its zero-priced hours line reporting the owed quantity and bills 5 units past the 20-unit allowance. The full unit suite passes apart from three pre-existing Influx/Redis connection failures unrelated to this change.
